A-CAL.purpose: Bounded two-player throughput calibration; diagnostic weights never deploy

A-PILOT-R0.prerequisite: Published calibration selection and equal pilot arena-step target

A-PILOT-R1.prerequisite: R0 fails validation gate; diagnosis and frozen matched configuration published

A-PILOT-R2.prerequisite: R1 fails validation gate; diagnosis and frozen matched configuration published

A-CONFIRM.prerequisite: Qualifying pilot, power analysis, selected reward and equal targets published

A-DIAG.prerequisite: Specific intervention/control/configuration published as dated amendment

LEGACY-5V5.prerequisite: No restart authorized; retain original deadlines and evidence
